cohort: Spiny mice offspring from dams randomly allocated to either a daily diet containing creatine or standard chow, and undergoing control caesarean section or birth asphyxia.
finding: Antenatal maternal creatine supplementation decreased anxiety-like behaviour in spiny mice offspring, ameliorating asphyxia-induced anxiety in the neonatal period.
gest_age: Delivery on gestational day 38 (term = 39 days for spiny mice).
